cond_0001.intro: The OHS Business Analyst will support the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support in ensuring the planning and execution of OHS strategic and operational initiatives that will support [Company name masked] overall agenda. This position interacts with [Location masked] Transit, [Company name masked] Bus, [Company name masked] HQ, MNR and LIRR on application enhancement and support. This includes, but not limited to managing the medical application, assist in implementing agencies Health & Safety programs and assist in overseeing all new operational requests for OHS. This position will interact with a wide range of stakeholders both within [Company name masked] IT and other agencies to ensure all necessary requirements and improvements meets OHS medical programs.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Supports interdepartmental [Company name masked] and interagency teams to execute projects critical to re-shaping [Company name masked] into more entrepreneurial and cost-effective agency such as city, state and federally mandated medical surveillance and drug and alcohol programs. Conducts business process reviews to ensure how to best improve current health and safety mandates. The OHS Business Analyst, through data analysis and operational support, identifies savings or ways to continue to improve Health and Safety. Identifies and pursues methods of improving medical related programs. The position will serve as primary support to Deputy Director OHS Operational Support. Additionally, supports the OHS $1.6 Million medical application and its various medical programs. Provides operational support in managing OHS medical application in order to support operating departments availability and increase efficiency. Under the direction of the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, additional specific responsibilities for:
Maintenance of all interfaces that update the medical application with employee demographic, hearing and drug and alcohol information.
Manage and administers medical application(s) by implementing custom reports, application design updates, security, and testing.
Manage the implementation of new medical programs to support [Company name masked]-wide initiatives.
Utilizes technology to improve existing and new [Company name masked] Health and Safety goals, which includes but not limited to physical ability testing, potential in house clinical testing and expanding [Company name masked] influenza programs.
Provides analytical support to all [Company name masked] agencies regarding surveillance programs, clinical testing, periodic medical exams and drug & alcohol testing. Also, builds business relationships with agency stakeholders to ensure these key programs are implemented and managed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field or an equivalent combination of education from an accredited college and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
A minimum of 3 years progressively responsible work or internship experience.
Excellent quantitative, analytical, project management and problem-solving skills, together with demonstrated quantitative skills and proficiency in Excel modeling.
Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the talent to communicate complex quantitative concepts in a clear and succinct way to internal stakeholders.
Strong interpersonal skills with an established history of working on projects requiring group consensus and cooperation among people with no direct reporting relationships.
Demonstrated ability to work in team and/or group settings, including gathering data from various stakeholders and interviewing stakeholders in a team or individual setting.
Ability to prioritize among competing needs and opportunities and manage multiple projects at the same time.
Demonstrated proficiency in or ability to learn the Microsoft Office Suite or comparable applications, i.e., Word, Excel (high level comprehensive Excel modeling such as Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, conditional If/Then statements), PowerPoint, Outlook, and PowerBI.
Pursuant to the [Location masked] Public Officers Law & the [Company name masked] Code of Ethics, all employees who hold a policymaking position must file an Annual Statement of Financial Disclosure (FDS) with the [Location masked] Commission on Ethics and Lobbying in Government (the Commission).
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree.
Must be capable of building a strong and successful network, developing new relationships and influencing decision makers.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn organizational and presentation skills.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn to work with all internal levels within a given organization.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn communicate and interact well with external agencies.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn completing short- and long-term projects effectively and as efficiently as possible.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn analytical and/or quantitative skills.

Conduct business process reviews to determine how best to improve current health and safety mandates. Through data analysis and operational support, identify savings and drive improvements to Health and Safety. Identify and pursue methods of improving medical-related programs. Serve as primary support to the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, and take ownership of the OHS $1.6 million medical application and its various medical programs. Direct operational management of the OHS medical application to ensure availability and efficiency for operating departments. Under the direction of the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, specific responsibilities include:
Maintain all interfaces that update the medical application with employee demographic, hearing, and drug and alcohol information.
Manage and administer medical application(s) by implementing custom reports, application design updates, security, and testing.
Lead the implementation of new medical programs to support [Company name masked]-wide initiatives.
Apply technology to advance existing and new [Company name masked] Health and Safety goals, including physical ability testing, potential in-house clinical testing, and expanding [Company name masked] influenza programs.
Deliver analytical support to all [Company name masked] agencies on surveillance programs, clinical testing, periodic medical exams, and drug & alcohol testing. Build and manage business relationships with agency stakeholders to ensure these key programs are implemented and sustained.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0008.requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education from an accredited college and experience in lieu of a degree.
A minimum of 3 years of progressively responsible work or internship experience.
Excellent quantitative, analytical, project management, and problem-solving skills, including proficiency in Excel modeling.
Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to convey complex quantitative concepts clearly to internal stakeholders.
Strong interpersonal skills with a history of working on projects requiring group consensus and cooperation among people with no direct reporting relationships.
Ability to build a strong network, develop new relationships, and influence decision makers.
Ability to gather data from and interview various stakeholders in team or individual settings.
Ability to prioritize among competing needs and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Proficiency in, or ability to learn, the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel including Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, and If/Then statements, PowerPoint, Outlook) and PowerBI.
Pursuant to the [Location masked] Public Officers Law and the [Company name masked] Code of Ethics, all employees who hold a policymaking position must file an Annual Statement of Financial Disclosure (FDS) with the [Location masked] Commission on Ethics and Lobbying in Government (the Commission).

Master's degree.
Proficiency in organizational and presentation skills.
Experience working across all internal levels within a given organization.
Experience communicating and interacting with external agencies.
Demonstrated ability to complete short- and long-term projects effectively and efficiently.

cond_0044.intro: The OHS Business Analyst will lead the planning and execution of OHS strategic and operational initiatives in support of [Company name masked]'s overall agenda. This position drives coordination with [Location masked] Transit, [Company name masked] Bus, [Company name masked] HQ, MNR and LIRR on application enhancement and support. Responsibilities include owning the medical application, leading implementation of agency Health & Safety programs, and directing all new operational requests for OHS. This position will engage a wide range of stakeholders within [Company name masked] IT and other agencies to ensure all requirements and improvements meet OHS medical programs.
cond_0044.responsibilities:
The Business Analyst will lead interdepartmental and interagency teams to execute projects critical to re-shaping [Company name masked] into a more entrepreneurial and cost-effective agency, including city, state, and federally mandated medical surveillance and drug and alcohol programs. Conduct business process reviews to determine how best to improve current health and safety mandates. Through data analysis and operational support, identify savings and drive improvements to Health and Safety. Identify and pursue methods of improving medical-related programs. Serve as primary support to the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, and take ownership of the OHS $1.6 million medical application and its various medical programs. Direct operational management of the OHS medical application to ensure availability and efficiency for operating departments. Under the direction of the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, specific responsibilities include:
Maintain all interfaces that update the medical application with employee demographic, hearing, and drug and alcohol information.
Manage and administer medical application(s) by implementing custom reports, application design updates, security, and testing.
Lead the implementation of new medical programs to support [Company name masked]-wide initiatives.
Apply technology to advance existing and new [Company name masked] Health and Safety goals, including physical ability testing, potential in-house clinical testing, and expanding [Company name masked] influenza programs.
Deliver analytical support to all [Company name masked] agencies on surveillance programs, clinical testing, periodic medical exams, and drug & alcohol testing. Build and manage business relationships with agency stakeholders to ensure these key programs are implemented and sustained.
Other duties as assigned.

This includes, but is not limited to, helping manage the medical application, assisting in implementing agencies' Health & Safety programs, and supporting all new operational requests for OHS. This position will work alongside a wide range of stakeholders both within [Company name masked] IT and other agencies to help ensure all necessary requirements and improvements meet OHS medical programs.
cond_0153.responsibilities:
Working alongside interdepartmental and interagency teams, this role helps execute projects critical to reshaping [Company name masked] into a more entrepreneurial and cost-effective agency, including city, state, and federally mandated medical surveillance and drug and alcohol programs. Collaborates on business process reviews to identify how best to improve current health and safety mandates. Through data analysis and operational support, the OHS Business Analyst works with others to identify savings or ways to continue improving Health and Safety. Coordinates with relevant teams to identify and pursue methods of improving medical-related programs. The position serves as primary support to the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, and assists in managing the OHS $1.6 Million medical application and its various medical programs. Provides operational support in managing the OHS medical application to help operating departments maintain availability and increase efficiency. Under the direction of the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, additional specific responsibilities include:
Coordinating maintenance of all interfaces that update the medical application with employee demographic, hearing, and drug and alcohol information.
Working with relevant teams to manage and administer medical application(s) by implementing custom reports, application design updates, security, and testing.
Supporting the implementation of new medical programs to advance [Company name masked]-wide initiatives.
Collaborating with stakeholders to apply technology in improving existing and new [Company name masked] Health and Safety goals, including but not limited to physical ability testing, potential in-house clinical testing, and expanding [Company name masked] influenza programs.
Providing analytical support to all [Company name masked] agencies regarding surveillance programs, clinical testing, periodic medical exams, and drug & alcohol testing. Also, builds working relationships with agency stakeholders to help ensure these key programs are implemented and managed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0153.requirements:
Minimum Requirements**
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education from an accredited college and experience in lieu of a degree.
A minimum of 3 years of progressively responsible work or internship experience.
Excellent quantitative, analytical, project management, and problem-solving skills, together with demonstrated proficiency in Excel modeling.
Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly and concisely to internal stakeholders.
Strong interpersonal skills with a demonstrated history of working on projects requiring group consensus and cooperation among people with no direct reporting relationships.
Demonstrated ability to work in team and/or group settings, including gathering data from and interviewing stakeholders.
Ability to prioritize among competing needs and manage multiple projects at the same time.
Proficiency in, or ability to learn, the Microsoft Office Suite or comparable applications, i.e., Word, Excel (including Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, and If/Then statements), PowerPoint, Outlook, and PowerBI.
Pursuant to the [Location masked] Public Officers Law & the [Company name masked] Code of Ethics, all employees who hold a policymaking position must file an Annual Statement of Financial Disclosure (FDS) with the [Location masked] Commission on Ethics and Lobbying in Government (the Commission).
Preferred Requirements**
Master's degree.
Ability to build a strong professional network, develop new relationships, and influence decision makers.
Proficiency in organizational and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with all internal levels within a given organization.
Ability to communicate and interact well with external agencies.
Ability to complete short- and long-term projects effectively and efficiently.

cond_0160.intro: The OHS Business Analyst will support the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support in ensuring the planning and execution of OHS strategic and operational initiatives that support [Company name masked]'s overall agenda. This position coordinates with [Location masked] Transit, [Company name masked] Bus, [Company name masked] HQ, MNR and LIRR on application enhancement and support. This includes managing the medical application, assisting in implementing agencies' Health & Safety programs, and assisting in overseeing all new operational requests for OHS. This position will interface with [Company name masked] IT and other agencies to ensure all necessary requirements and improvements meet OHS medical programs.
cond_0160.responsibilities:
Supports interdepartmental and interagency teams to execute projects critical to re-shaping [Company name masked] into a more cost-effective agency, such as city, state and federally mandated medical surveillance and drug and alcohol programs. Conducts business process reviews to identify how to best improve current health and safety mandates. Through data analysis and operational support, identifies savings or ways to continue to improve Health and Safety. Identifies methods of improving medical related programs. The position serves as primary support to Deputy Director OHS Operational Support. Additionally, supports the OHS $1.6 Million medical application and its various medical programs. Provides operational support in managing the OHS medical application to support operating departments' availability and increase efficiency. Under the direction of the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, specific responsibilities include:
Maintenance of all interfaces that update the medical application with employee demographic, hearing and drug and alcohol information.
Manages and administers medical application(s) by implementing custom reports, application design updates, security, and testing.
Manages the implementation of new medical programs to support [Company name masked]-wide initiatives.
Utilizes technology to improve existing and new [Company name masked] Health and Safety goals, including physical ability testing, potential in-house clinical testing and expanding [Company name masked] influenza programs.
Provides analytical support to [Company name masked] agencies regarding surveillance programs, clinical testing, periodic medical exams and drug & alcohol testing. Coordinates with agency stakeholders to ensure these programs are implemented and managed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0160.requirements:
Strong quantitative, analytical, project management and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated proficiency in Excel modeling.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting, with the ability to convey complex quantitative concepts in a clear and succinct way to internal stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to work on projects requiring group consensus and cooperation among people with no direct reporting relationships.
Ability to gather data from various stakeholders and conduct stakeholder interviews in team or individual settings.
Ability to prioritize among competing needs and manage multiple projects at the same time.
Proficiency in or ability to learn organizational and presentation skills.
Proficiency in or ability to learn to work with all internal levels within a given organization.
Proficiency in or ability to learn to communicate and coordinate with external agencies.
Proficiency in or ability to learn completing short- and long-term projects effectively and efficiently.
Proficiency in or ability to learn analytical and/or quantitative skills.
Demonstrated proficiency in or ability to learn the Microsoft Office Suite or comparable applications, i.e., Word, Excel (including Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, conditional If/Then statements), PowerPoint, Outlook, and PowerBI.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education from an accredited college and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree; master's degree preferred.
A minimum of 3 years of progressively responsible work or internship experience.
Pursuant to the [Location masked] Public Officers Law & the [Company name masked] Code of Ethics, all employees who hold a policymaking position must file an Annual Statement of Financial Disclosure (FDS) with the [Location masked] Commission on Ethics and Lobbying in Government (the Commission).

cond_0206.intro: The OHS Business Analyst will lead the planning and execution of OHS strategic and operational initiatives in support of [Company name masked]'s overall agenda. This position drives coordination with [Location masked] Transit, [Company name masked] Bus, [Company name masked] HQ, MNR and LIRR on application enhancement and support. Responsibilities include owning the medical application, leading implementation of agency Health & Safety programs, and directing all new operational requests for OHS. This position will engage a wide range of stakeholders within [Company name masked] IT and other agencies to ensure all requirements and improvements meet OHS medical programs.

The Business Analyst will lead interdepartmental and interagency teams to execute projects critical to re-shaping [Company name masked] into a more entrepreneurial and cost-effective agency, including city, state, and federally mandated medical surveillance and drug and alcohol programs. Conduct business process reviews to determine how best to improve current health and safety mandates. Through data analysis and operational support, identify savings and drive improvements to Health and Safety. Identify and pursue methods of improving medical-related programs. Serve as primary support to the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, and take ownership of the OHS $1.6 million medical application and its various medical programs. Direct operational management of the OHS medical application to ensure availability and efficiency for operating departments. Under the direction of the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, specific responsibilities include:
Maintain all interfaces that update the medical application with employee demographic, hearing, and drug and alcohol information.
Manage and administer medical application(s) by implementing custom reports, application design updates, security, and testing.
Lead the implementation of new medical programs to support [Company name masked]-wide initiatives.
Apply technology to advance existing and new [Company name masked] Health and Safety goals, including physical ability testing, potential in-house clinical testing, and expanding [Company name masked] influenza programs.
Deliver analytical support to all [Company name masked] agencies on surveillance programs, clinical testing, periodic medical exams, and drug & alcohol testing. Build and manage business relationships with agency stakeholders to ensure these key programs are implemented and sustained.
Other duties as assigned.

cond_0352.intro: The OHS Business Analyst will support the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support in ensuring the planning and execution of OHS strategic and operational initiatives that will support [Company name masked] overall agenda. This position interacts with [Location masked] Transit, [Company name masked] Bus, [Company name masked] HQ, MNR and LIRR on application enhancement and support. This includes, but not limited to managing the medical application, assist in implementing agencies Health & Safety programs and assist in overseeing all new operational requests for OHS. This position will interact with a wide range of stakeholders both within [Company name masked] IT and other agencies to ensure all necessary requirements and improvements meets OHS medical programs.
cond_0352.responsibilities:
Supports interdepartmental [Company name masked] and interagency teams to execute projects critical to re-shaping [Company name masked] into more entrepreneurial and cost-effective agency such as city, state and federally mandated medical surveillance and drug and alcohol programs. Conducts business process reviews to ensure how to best improve current health and safety mandates. The OHS Business Analyst, through data analysis and operational support, identifies savings or ways to continue to improve Health and Safety. Identifies and pursues methods of improving medical related programs. The position will serve as primary support to Deputy Director OHS Operational Support. Additionally, supports the OHS $1.6 Million medical application and its various medical programs. Provides operational support in managing OHS medical application in order to support operating departments availability and increase efficiency. Under the direction of the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, additional specific responsibilities for:
Maintenance of all interfaces that update the medical application with employee demographic, hearing and drug and alcohol information.
Manage and administers medical application(s) by implementing custom reports, application design updates, security, and testing.
Manage the implementation of new medical programs to support [Company name masked]-wide initiatives.
Utilizes technology to improve existing and new [Company name masked] Health and Safety goals, which includes but not limited to physical ability testing, potential in house clinical testing and expanding [Company name masked] influenza programs.
Provides analytical support to all [Company name masked] agencies regarding surveillance programs, clinical testing, periodic medical exams and drug & alcohol testing. Also, builds business relationships with agency stakeholders to ensure these key programs are implemented and managed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0352.requirements:
Excellent quantitative, analytical, project management and problem-solving skills, together with demonstrated quantitative skills and proficiency in Excel modeling.
Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the talent to communicate complex quantitative concepts in a clear and succinct way to internal stakeholders.
Strong interpersonal skills with an established history of working on projects requiring group consensus and cooperation among people with no direct reporting relationships.
Must be capable of building a strong and successful network, developing new relationships and influencing decision makers.
Demonstrated ability to work in team and/or group settings, including gathering data from various stakeholders and interviewing stakeholders in a team or individual setting.
Ability to prioritize among competing needs and opportunities and manage multiple projects at the same time.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn organizational and presentation skills.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn to work with all internal levels within a given organization.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn communicate and interact well with external agencies.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn completing short- and long-term projects effectively and as efficiently as possible.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn analytical and/or quantitative skills.
Demonstrated proficiency in or ability to learn the Microsoft Office Suite or comparable applications, i.e., Word, Excel (high level comprehensive Excel modeling such as Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, conditional If/Then statements), PowerPoint, Outlook, and PowerBI.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field or an equivalent combination of education from an accredited college and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree; master's degree preferred.
A minimum of 3 years progressively responsible work or internship experience.
Pursuant to the [Location masked] Public Officers Law & the [Company name masked] Code of Ethics, all employees who hold a policymaking position must file an Annual Statement of Financial Disclosure (FDS) with the [Location masked] Commission on Ethics and Lobbying in Government (the Commission).

cond_0388.intro: The OHS Business Analyst will support the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support in ensuring the planning and execution of OHS strategic and operational initiatives that will support [Company name masked] overall agenda. This position interacts with [Location masked] Transit, [Company name masked] Bus, [Company name masked] HQ, MNR and LIRR on application enhancement and support. This includes, but not limited to managing the medical application, assist in implementing agencies Health & Safety programs and assist in overseeing all new operational requests for OHS. This position will interact with a wide range of stakeholders both within [Company name masked] IT and other agencies to ensure all necessary requirements and improvements meets OHS medical programs.
cond_0388.responsibilities:
Supports interdepartmental [Company name masked] and interagency teams to execute projects critical to re-shaping [Company name masked] into more entrepreneurial and cost-effective agency such as city, state and federally mandated medical surveillance and drug and alcohol programs. Conducts business process reviews to ensure how to best improve current health and safety mandates. The OHS Business Analyst, through data analysis and operational support, identifies savings or ways to continue to improve Health and Safety. Identifies and pursues methods of improving medical related programs. The position will serve as primary support to Deputy Director OHS Operational Support. Additionally, supports the OHS $1.6 Million medical application and its various medical programs. Provides operational support in managing OHS medical application in order to support operating departments availability and increase efficiency. Under the direction of the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, additional specific responsibilities for:
Maintenance of all interfaces that update the medical application with employee demographic, hearing and drug and alcohol information.
Manage and administers medical application(s) by implementing custom reports, application design updates, security, and testing.
Manage the implementation of new medical programs to support [Company name masked]-wide initiatives.
Utilizes technology to improve existing and new [Company name masked] Health and Safety goals, which includes but not limited to physical ability testing, potential in house clinical testing and expanding [Company name masked] influenza programs.
Provides analytical support to all [Company name masked] agencies regarding surveillance programs, clinical testing, periodic medical exams and drug & alcohol testing. Also, builds business relationships with agency stakeholders to ensure these key programs are implemented and managed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0388.requirements:
Excellent quantitative, analytical, project management and problem-solving skills, together with demonstrated quantitative skills and proficiency in Excel modeling.
Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the talent to communicate complex quantitative concepts in a clear and succinct way to internal stakeholders.
Strong interpersonal skills with an established history of working on projects requiring group consensus and cooperation among people with no direct reporting relationships.
Must be capable of building a strong and successful network, developing new relationships and influencing decision makers.
Demonstrated ability to work in team and/or group settings, including gathering data from various stakeholders and interviewing stakeholders in a team or individual setting.
Ability to prioritize among competing needs and opportunities and manage multiple projects at the same time.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn organizational and presentation skills.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn to work with all internal levels within a given organization.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn communicate and interact well with external agencies.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn completing short- and long-term projects effectively and as efficiently as possible.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn analytical and/or quantitative skills.
Demonstrated proficiency in or ability to learn the Microsoft Office Suite or comparable applications, i.e., Word, Excel (high level comprehensive Excel modeling such as Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, conditional If/Then statements), PowerPoint, Outlook, and PowerBI.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field or an equivalent combination of education from an accredited college and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree; master's degree preferred.
A minimum of 3 years progressively responsible work or internship experience.

cond_0555.intro: We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our team. This role supports the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support in planning and executing OHS strategic and operational initiatives. The position regularly interacts with stakeholders across multiple agencies on application enhancement and support, including managing the medical application, helping implement Health & Safety programs, and handling new operational requests for OHS. A large part of the role is staying in contact with a wide range of stakeholders both within [Company name masked] IT and other agencies to ensure requirements and improvements meet OHS medical programs.
cond_0555.responsibilities:
Actively supports interdepartmental and interagency teams to execute projects critical to re-shaping [Company name masked] into a more cost-effective agency, including city, state, and federally mandated medical surveillance and drug and alcohol programs. Conducts business process reviews to identify how to best improve current health and safety mandates. Through data analysis and operational support, identifies savings or ways to continue to improve Health and Safety, and regularly connects with stakeholders to pursue methods of improving medical related programs. Serves as primary support to the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, and supports the OHS $1.6 million medical application and its various medical programs. Provides operational support in managing the OHS medical application to support operating departments and increase efficiency. Under the direction of the Deputy Director, OHS Operational Support, additional specific responsibilities include:
Maintenance of all interfaces that update the medical application with employee demographic, hearing, and drug and alcohol information.
Manage and administer medical application(s) by implementing custom reports, application design updates, security, and testing.
Manage the implementation of new medical programs to support [Company name masked]-wide initiatives.
Utilize technology to improve existing and new [Company name masked] Health and Safety goals, including physical ability testing, potential in-house clinical testing, and expanding [Company name masked] influenza programs.
Provide analytical support to all [Company name masked] agencies regarding surveillance programs, clinical testing, periodic medical exams, and drug & alcohol testing. Build and maintain business relationships with agency stakeholders to ensure these key programs are implemented and managed.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0555.requirements:
Excellent quantitative, analytical, project management, and problem-solving skills, together with demonstrated proficiency in Excel modeling.
Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to explain complex quantitative concepts clearly and directly to internal stakeholders.
Strong interpersonal skills with a demonstrated history of working on projects requiring group consensus and cooperation among people with no direct reporting relationships.
Able to build a strong network, develop new relationships, and engage with decision makers.
Demonstrated ability to work in team and/or group settings, including gathering data from various stakeholders and interviewing stakeholders in a team or individual setting.
Ability to prioritize among competing needs and manage multiple projects at the same time.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn organizational and presentation skills.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn to work with all internal levels within a given organization.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn to communicate and interact well with external agencies.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn completing short- and long-term projects effectively and efficiently.
Proficiency in and/or ability to learn analytical and/or quantitative skills.
Demonstrated proficiency in or ability to learn the Microsoft Office Suite or comparable applications, i.e., Word, Excel (including Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, conditional If/Then statements), PowerPoint, Outlook, and PowerBI.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education from an accredited college and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree; master's degree preferred.
